items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: The leader was their chauffeur. His name was Armand, A-R-M-A-N-D.

ctx.x: I like that song on there.

My grandmother is actually the one who got me interested in music. She used to play piano a little bit and she'd get songs and knew enough about them. I remember probably the first two that she tried to teach me was one of them. Oh, my baby, my curly-headed baby, we'll sit beneath the sky and sing a song to the moon. That was one of them. And the other one was, I forget. But then I had an aunt that made a trip to Hawaii and brought back the first ukulele that I ever saw in my life. She brought it to me. And I…
